name: Setup CRM
description: Set up a basic CRM by logging the client as the first entry and sending a welcome email

steps.description: Log the client as the first CRM entry
Generate a CRM welcome sequence outline

params_template.prompt: Create a 5-email welcome sequence for a new client named {client_name} who just launched {business_name}. Include subject lines and body copy for each email.

steps.description: Save the CRM welcome sequence to disk
Send CRM setup confirmation email to client

params_template.subject: Your Q-Empire CRM is Ready 🚀
params_template.body:
Hi {client_name},

Your CRM has been set up by Q-Bot! We've logged your business profile for {business_name} and created a welcome email sequence to help you convert your first clients.

Your empire is growing!

— Michelle & Q-Bot 🧜🏾‍♀️
